messages:
anna (AE): Heads up — Dealbotics asked for a tight POC window. Can we align on the concrete success metrics and which endpoints to prioritize?

sam (SE): Quick note: their main ask is an automated support triage + KB answer flow, plus a monitoring signal for when hallucinations spike.

mike (PM): High-level success criteria idea: 1) intent classification F1 >= 0.85 on their test set, 2) median inference latency < 250ms for 8k-context chat, 3) cost <= $X per 10k queries (TBD).

lee (Security): Security checklist items they've flagged: data residency (EU only), KMS integration, and audit logs retention. Also want confirmation on SOC2 and penetration testing cadence.

anna (AE): Timeline they proposed: 4 weeks, demo at end. We suggested 5 weeks to be safe. Thoughts on moving faster with Redwood Dedicated or Private?

sam (SE): If they use Dedicated we can guarantee lower tail latency and isolate KV cache. For a 4-week POC we can offer a short reserved slot + engineer hours. Private adds overhead (infra prep) — probably adds ~2 weeks.

mike (PM): Proposal: 4-week POC with Hosted + reserved Dedicated fallback. Week 0: infra + creds. Week 1: embed pipeline + sample endpoints. Week 2: evals + refine prompts. Week 3: load run + tuning. Week 4: acceptance + handover.

anna (AE): Endpoints we should expose for the POC (ranked): 1) `/chat/support-triage` (primary), 2) `/embed/search-kb`, 3) `/rerank/candidates`, 4) `/metrics/hallucination-alerts` (webhook).

sam (SE): Implementation notes: for `/embed/search-kb` use batch embeddings with vector DB stub. Provide sample code:

```
POST /v1/embeddings
{ "model": "redwood-embed-1", "input": ["doc text..."] }
```

sam (SE): For hallucination signal, we can add a reranker that checks support answer against KB and emit a `confidence < 0.7` metric to their Sentry/Datadog.

lee (Security): Data flows: need a diagram but short answer: hosted API -> encrypted in transit, request bodies not stored unless they opt in; logs redacted. We'll send standard controls doc. Also they want customer-managed keys for Private.

anna (AE): Pricing Qs from Dealbotics: can we provide a trial uplift for throughput on week 3, and an estimate for sustained 200 qps on Dedicated?

sam (SE): Yes — trial uplift possible. Preliminary Dedicated estimate: ~4x cheaper per 1M tokens vs burst-hosted at their expected batch size, but I'll run numbers with ops.

mike (PM): Acceptance tests (concrete):
- integration smoke: samples from `/chat/support-triage` return expected JSON schema.
- quality: 100 labeled queries, accuracy F1 >= 0.85 for intent + top-1 KB match precision >= 0.8.
- perf: p95 latency < 400ms, p99 < 800ms under their traffic profile.
- security: keys rotated, audit log accessible, EU residency confirmed.

anna (AE): Can someone own the eval harness and run the first pass by Friday? Dealbotics wants an initial readout Monday.

sam (SE): I can wire up the harness and run baseline tests by Friday morning. Will need their sample dataset and DB snapshot. @anna can you get that?

anna (AE): I'll push for the dataset today, and share credentials via secure vault.

lee (Security): I'll prep the controls doc and note Private vs Dedicated KMS differences. Send me their legal contact so I can add a quick questionnaire response.

infra-bot: deploy scheduled: reserved-dedicated-slot -> 2025-10-02T03:00:00Z (ETA: 4h).

mike (PM): OK — next actions: 1) anna get dataset + creds, 2) sam build eval harness (due Fri), 3) lee send controls doc (EOD), 4) ops confirm Dedicated pricing numbers (Mon).

anna (AE): Perfect. I'll update Dealbotics with the proposed 4-week plan and the acceptance criteria. Thanks all :thumbsup:
